title: The Spaces directory is slow on a phone: every card photo loads at once, and a Space with no cover pulls a full-size brand photo

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-19 (project thread: Speed up Themes and Spaces on mobile): "The Spaces page takes a long time to load on mobile".

detail: /spaces/directory (the Spaces menu item) draws up to twenty cards (featured, founding, results) and each card's photo was a CSS background, which the browser fetches for every card at once, offscreen or not. A Space with no cover fell back to one of 17 brand photos at 1086px, 200 to 430 KB each. Fix: the card photo is a lazy with the same cover framing, and the fallback is the 640px copy in public/brand/frequency/photos/sm (30 to 85 KB). Still open beyond this row: covers and logos uploaded before PERF-012 (#5320) are stored at original size (one logo shown at 28px is 1.37 MB); those need a one-off shrink of the stored files, which is an owner call. DONE 2026-11-19: Space cards load lazily and the no-cover fallback is the 640px copy.

verify.note: Passes while Space cards load lazily and every fallback photo has a 640px copy under 100 KB. Fails on main at 4ba501ac.
